title: Insurtech for all: Reimagining India’s insurance future
description: Insurers may be digitising quickly, but few have harnessed the full power of India’s insurtech revolution: technology, regulation and ecosystem collaboration. Vishal Gupta of PhonePe Insurance decodes how innovation, when aligned with policy and purpose, transforms insurance from an annual obligation to an intelligent and proactive service for every Indian.

title: Predict, prevent, protect: Building next-gen payment systems
description: Predictive AI is reshaping digital payments—anticipating failures, detecting fraud in real time, and powering resilient, self-correcting infrastructure. Satyajit Kanekar of 86400 explores how this is enhancing accuracy, uptime, and trust across fintech, telecom, and banking while ensuring regulatory compliance.

title: Assisted to autonomous: AI and the future of fintech
description: AI is transforming financial services from reactive to proactive, and now, autonomous. From credit underwriting and payment gateways to fraud detection and personalised portfolio management, fintech startups are leveraging intelligent, hyper-personalised systems to make finance smarter, more inclusive, and human for a billion Indians.

title: Deepening India's deeptech vision with robotics in real-world systems
description: As AI transforms core industries, India stands at the cusp of an industrial leap. The challenge now is scaling AI beyond software into machines, factories, and orbits. Can India build the data, compute, and policy backbone to power intelligent manufacturing, robotics, and spacetech at scale?

title: India’s deeptech decade: From jugaad to AI-first innovation
description: India's next startup ecosystem growth won't be from consumer apps but from deeptech. However, these ventures need more than funding—they need conviction, patience, and ecosystem backing. As India’s future innovators tackle spacetech, energy, and advanced materials, VC investing must evolve to enable long-term growth.

title: Confrontation to compassion: Embedding empathy into debt collection with AI
description: Traditionally, debt collection has been a transactional and confrontational process. Today, it is transforming into a collaborative and empathetic experience, powered by AI. Ananth Shroff, Founder & CEO of DPDzero, explores how AI and GenAI tools, from behavioural analysis to real-time sentiment adaptation, are enabling ethical, personalised, and human-centred repayment experiences that build trust, not tension.

title: CEO's guide to building the world's most intelligent fashion platform
description: AI is in vogue as Myntra CEO Nandita Sinha leads the charge to build an AI-powered, creator-led global fashion business that keeps winning. Here's how.

title: Soil to satellite: Future of smart farming for India
description: Empowered by AI and deeptech, India's agri economy is set to see yet another revolution. What will be the on-ground impact of GenAI, IoT, satellite imagery, and other innovations on this industry and India's farm output? Deep dive into how innovators are building a connected ecosystem to enhance farmer livelihoods through intelligent, scalable solutions.

title: Breaking the bottlenecks: Inside India’s AI infrastructure struggle
description: Every breakthrough AI model in India hits the same invisible walls -- bandwidth, throughput, and “good enough” infrastructure. E2E Networks' Mohammed Imran, a pioneer in open-source cloud innovation, decodes how India can build systems that make world-class AI performance truly accessible.

title: Making AI real: Where creativity meets intelligence and scale
description: AI’s real power lies not merely in models, but in marrying imagination with execution. From creative workflows to massive datasets and real-time decision engines, the future belongs to organisations that can effectively blend human inventiveness with scalable intelligence. This is how organisations can translate powerful AI models and future-forward ideas into real-world, operational products and services, and deliver value at industrial scale.

title: The borderless blueprint: Sweden and India’s innovation alliance
description: As part of the Sweden India Innovation Bridge, India and Sweden are rewriting the playbook for collaboration across technology, investment, government, academia, entrepreneurship and more. Hear how this ecosystem is building bridges that go beyond partnerships - shaping how innovation truly works in a borderless world.

title: India: The new epicenter of enterprise tech buying
description: Enterprise technology buying has quietly shifted from global headquarters to India’s Global Capability Centers (GCCs). Sankara Srinivasan, Co-founder of Koot.business, explores how GCCs have become the new nerve centres of enterprise decision-making, and what this means for SaaS founders, investors, and partners looking to tap global enterprise markets from India.

title: Art of storytelling: How authentic narratives build trust, attract capital, and create loyal communities
description: How can authentic storytelling serve as a powerful tool to build trust, attract capital, and nurture loyal communities? Kunal Kapoor, actor and co-founder of Ketto, shares insights from his entrepreneurial journey on translating purpose and passion into narratives that inspire action and drive impact.
